proof:
change ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (p q : M6.Euclid.BP), (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).passes = 2 * (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).cancellations + 3 * (M6.Euclid.euclidAux fuel p q).rounds + 1
intro fuel
induction fuel with
| zero =>
    intro p q
    rfl
| succ fuel ih =>
    intro p q
    classical
    simp only [M6.Euclid.euclidAux]
    split <;> simp [M6.Euclid.remainder, M6.Euclid.remainder_passes, ih,
      Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
